scope.task: Prepare a source-grounded technical response matrix, retaining supplier service and documentation obligations.
scope.statement: First-pass source-region annotation of physical pages 1-7 only. Pages 8-20 remain unreviewed, including the tender form, Annexure A response templates, and Annexure B contract terms. The 93 numbered specification rows on pages 4-7 are represented as draft row labels; compound rows remain explicitly pending atomicity adjudication. This is development material, not gold or an evaluation result.

review.method: Assistant first-pass using Poppler pdftotext -layout and rendered page review. Quotes are whitespace-normalized source anchors checked against the specified page. Page-level visual positions are only approximate/page-only; no production parser IDs, offsets, or geometry were assigned. Pages 4-7 were rendered at 140 DPI and inspected visually. The 93 numbered specification rows were inventoried from the source text layer, then each anchor was verified against its physical page. Values are stored as raw text tokens only and their semantic role/normalization remains pending independent review.

reviewers.role: assistant first-pass; independent human review required
